purpose: Data-readiness audit only; no fitting, model inference, prediction, or leaderboard query.
selection: Group by NFKC and whitespace-normalized problem text; classify prior exposure before selecting holdout. Quarantine every old final group. Only groups absent from all prior development/tuning and final groups may enter the fresh holdout.
holdout_order: Ascending sha256('aimo-main-v2-holdout-20260920:' + normalized_problem_hash), independent of labels, model and reasoning effort.
insufficient_fresh_groups: Do not substitute exposed groups or resample. Mark fresh holdout unavailable and require a separately justified evaluation design.
labels: No holdout problem text, label, max_drop, model-specific counts or predictions printed. Training summary may report aggregate label/configuration counts. Unlabelled rows excluded from supervised development.
immutability: Existing files are never overwritten; preserve downloaded bytes and SHA256. Future runs must verify all recorded input hashes.
limits: USD 0; at most 10 MiB download; no GPU or hosted inference; 60 second per HTTP request.
